notes.title: Ver. 1.04 Now Available!
notes.notes:

-Dualshock icons no longer display in the "Peace" Yang Skill description regardless of input method

notes.title: Ver. 1.02 Now Available!
notes.notes:
We have released Ver. 1.02.
Thank you for your patience. This update addresses the following issues:

Bug fixes:
-Frame rate in areas with large numbers of enemies has been improved
-Several English text issues have been addressed
-When a language other than Japanese is selected, all areas on the Save screen can now be clicked

We are currently looking into the issue that users have reported with the visual novel text scrolling automatically. Thank you to all users who sent us reports on this. Unfortunately, are are still unable to determine the cause or reproduce it. We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue working to resolve this issue.

notes.title: Ver. 1.01 Now Available!
notes.notes:
We have released Ver. 1.01.
This update addresses the following issues:

Bug fixes:
-Subtitles for a portion of Homura's "Navigator" voice lines are now displaying correctly in English and French
-Unlock condition for the "Path of the Shinobi" achievement has been corrected

Issues we are looking into:
-Certain novel text scrolls too quickly to read

If you purchased the Tailor-Made Limited Edition and are unable to access the limited DLC content, please try restarting your Steam client.

We are currently looking into why users who pre-ordered the game have not received the Beautiful Something Yukata. We apologize for the delay and hope to have a solution shortly.
